channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, AI, Tech & Research, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Pivotal Research Fellowship (2027 Q1)
item.description: Pivotal Research · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · £15,000 to £18,000 stipend (£18,000 for senior fellows, e.g. PhD, industry track record or strong publications) + travel to and from London + £1,800/month housing for non-London fellows + weekday lunch and dinner + compute.

item.title: Tate x Delfina Foundation: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (London)
item.description: Tate and Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Non-salaried but fully supported: return economy-class flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement and visa support via Delfina Foundation, a living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, a London Underground and bus travel pass, a single bedroom at Delfina Foundation with shared facilities, and travel to other Tate galleries and UK/European cultural institutions. The Leonora Carrington fellowship adds a research resource allowance. No application fee.

item.title: Institute for Law & AI: Winter Research Fellowship EU Law 2027 (Cambridge, UK)
item.description: Institute for Law & AI (LawAI) · deadline 12 Oct 2026 · GBP 1,000 weekly stipend for the 10-week fellowship (GBP 10,000 total), plus a GBP 7,000 relocation and housing payment. No application fee.

item.title: IAPS: AI Policy Fellowship Spring 2027 (DC, London or remote)
item.description: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · Fellows receive USD 18,000 and Senior Fellows USD 24,000 as a stipend for the three-month full-time program, plus an additional USD 3,000 stipend on the in-person DC or London tracks, healthcare benefits and a USD 500 professional development stipend. Up to 45 fellows. No application fee.

item.title: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (Tate Britain x Delfina Foundation)
item.description: Tate, in collaboration with Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Fully funded 6-month fellowship: living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, single bedroom at Delfina Foundation (house of up to 8 residents with shared facilities), return economy flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement with visa support, London Underground and bus travel pass, a research resource allowance, and travel to other Tate galleries (Tate Modern, Liverpool, St Ives) and other UK and European cultural institutions. Two fellowships available. No application fee.

item.title: LASR Labs Winter 2027 (London AI Safety Research)
item.description: LASR Labs, hosted at the London Initiative for Safe AI (LISA) · deadline 20 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 stipend for the 13-week programme, plus food, office space, and flights/travel. No application fee.

item.title: ILIAD Fellowship: Mentored AI Alignment Research (November and December 2026 cohorts)
item.description: ILIAD · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 6,000 per month travel-and-housing allowance for the 3-month fellowship. No tuition or application fee.

item.title: MATS Residency Program: 6-24 Month Funded AI Safety Research (Winter 2027 intake)
item.description: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars) · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 155,000 to 285,000 per year gross (set by location, seniority, and experience), plus medical/dental/vision/life insurance, retirement plan, paid time off, conference funding, catered meals, and up to USD 25,000 relocation support. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic Fellows Program (funded AI research fellowship, January 2027 cohort)
item.description: Anthropic (with Constellation as recruiting partner) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,850 / GBP 2,310 / CAD 4,300 per week for four months of full-time research, plus roughly USD 15,000 per month in compute funding and other research expenses. No application fee.

item.title: ERA:AI Fellowship 2027 (Winter cohort, Cambridge)
item.description: ERA Fellowship · deadline 13 Sep 2026 · GBP 10,000 stipend for the 10-week fellowship, plus visa support, travel expense coverage and meals during working hours. Top performers can receive 6+ month extensions through the Research Scholars programme. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new AI, Tech & Research fellowships - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• BOLD Fellow, British Open-ended Learning and Discovery Lab
    https://eng.ox.ac.uk/jobs/job-detail?vacancyID=187853
    University of Oxford, Department of Engineering Science (BOLD Lab, with UCL and Imperial College London) · deadline 15 Sep 2026 · Salary on Oxford Grade 10R, GBP 65,336 to GBP 84,663 per year, with the posting noting that further salary options are being explored. Benefits include associate membership at Reuben College, 38 days annual leave, pension scheme, childcare services, and travel expenses for stakeholder and conference visits. Fellows also get access to substantial compute: 3 million GPU hours on Isambard for the first 18 months, with the lab working towards 5,000 H100-equivalents in total across industry and government support. No application fee.
  • ILIAD Intensive: Foundational AI Alignment Program (London and Berkeley)
    https://www.iliad.ac/intensive
    ILIAD · deadline Rolling / undated · No tuition. USD 5,000 travel and housing allowance per participant, plus office space at the venue and lunch and dinner five days a week. Cohorts of 15 to 30 participants. Participants arrange and pay for their own travel and accommodation out of the allowance.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research fellowship - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• AIXI Labs: Research Fellowship (rolling, quarterly rounds)
    https://www.aixi.uk/team/opportunities/aixi-labs-fellowship/
    AIXI Labs · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 2,000 to GBP 3,500 per month stipend, plus a compute budget for machine-learning work. Free to apply.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research fellowship - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    https://jobs.arts.ac.uk/job/12629-storytelling-research-fellows/
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.
